in_marathi.name: Agneya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Agneya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Agneya is a name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Agni’, which means fire. This name is given to honor the Fire God, who is considered a deity in Hinduism and is revered for his power and strength. Agneya is a powerful and spiritual name that symbolizes courage, wisdom, and purity.
